title: CNN and MS NOW denied White House access after Trump announces ban - NBC News
description: Journalists from MS NOW and CNN said Saturday that they have been denied access to the White House grounds, a day after President Donald Trump said on social media that he had banned the news outlets and Politico over what he called their “constant ‘reporting…

title: Lane Kiffin returns to Ole Miss, and draws a very profane chant - NBC Sports
description: Football's equivalent of the Joker returns to Gotham City on Saturday, when coach Lane Kiffin's LSU team plays at Ole Miss, the program he ditched during a playoff season.

title: Smoke seen near Riyadh airport after air raid alerts in Saudi capital - BBC
description: The King Khalid International Airport incident caused hours of flight disruptions and comes amid an escalating conflict with Houthi rebels in Yemen.

title: Replay review confirms goal-line stop as Texas Tech tops Houston - ESPN
description: No. 13 Texas Tech held on for a 28-26 victory over No. 22 Houston as Cougars quarterback Conner Weigman came up just short on a 2-point conversion in the final minute.

title: A woman's postpartum symptoms wouldn't go away. A brain tumor was to blame. - CBS News
description: Lisa Fasone's first pregnancy went smoothly. Then a rare health condition put her dreams of a second child on hold.
